title: Request traces
intro: Find database calls, logs, and errors that share a trace ID.
limits: Recorded events only, newest received first. Sampling, redaction, retention, and dropped events may leave gaps. This view shows correlation, not a complete request waterfall.
setup: Use the Node SDK withTrace helper around a request handler, then follow View request trace from a recorded event or database call.
invalid: Enter a nonzero trace ID with 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
empty: No records for this trace in the selected window.
